generator: tools/make_independent_plant_ifc.py --seed 1 (independent water treatment works; labels set at element creation, not in the IFC)
convention: Labels are design intent, set where each element is created, from the descriptions in default-schema.json only (not from any classifier rule, and not in the IFC). A pipe, fitting or valve takes the line it belongs to: process and chemical lines inside the works are PIP/PRC (division 40), instrument air and air-scour lines PIP/UTL, manual valves PIP/VLV, hangers and sleepers PIP/SUP; buried yard mains and sewers are CIV/UTL or CIV/DRN (division 33); piping inside the administration building follows its trade (MEC/HYD, PLB/SUP, PLB/DRN, PLB/STM, FPR/SPR). Process pumps, blowers, filters and chemical tanks are PIP (division 43; 46 for treatment equipment such as filters, mixers and scrapers). Motors are ELE/PWR. Control valves, transmitters and analysers are INS (division 40; 25 for controllers and junction boxes). Equipment plinths outside buildings are CIV/FND, inside buildings STR/FND. Concrete basin floors are STR/SLB and basin walls STR/WLS. Paving and kerbs are CIV/PAV (32), fence, gate and trees CIV/LND. Wherever a second answer is defensible it is listed in alt: subDiscipline (same discipline) and division are used by the lenient column; alt.discipline and alt.also (cross-discipline "DISC/sub" pairs) are informational only. Elements with no name, or a proxy class where a proper one exists, keep the label of what they really are.
